topics.label: Constant-Coefficient ODEs: CF, Undetermined Coefficients, Resonance
topics.summary: How the roots of the auxiliary equation fix the complementary function, how undetermined coefficients finds a particular integral, and what to do when the guess collides with the CF.

subtopics.label: The Homogeneous Case: Complementary Function
subtopics.summary: Three root cases and why each solution form arises.

subtopics.label: Method of Undetermined Coefficients: Particular Integral
subtopics.summary: Guess-and-match for exponential, trigonometric and polynomial right-hand sides.

subtopics.label: The Failure Case (Resonance)
subtopics.summary: Multiply the guess by x (or x²) when it already appears in the CF.

subtopics.label: Putting It Together: Initial Conditions
subtopics.summary: Combine CF and PI, then apply initial conditions.

topics.label: Variation of Parameters
topics.summary: Derives the variation-of-parameters formula for a particular integral and shows when to prefer it over undetermined coefficients.

topics.label: The Cauchy–Euler Equation
topics.summary: Reduces x²y''+axy'+by=R(x) to constant coefficients with x = e^t, with the auxiliary equation m(m−1)+am+b=0.

topics.label: The Cauchy–Legendre Equation
topics.summary: Extends Cauchy–Euler to powers of (ax+b) using the substitution ax+b = e^t.

topics.label: Applications of Second-Order Linear ODEs
topics.summary: Spring–mass–damper and LCR circuit models, the three damping regimes, and resonance.

subtopics.label: Spring–mass–damper
subtopics.summary: Newton's law gives mx''+cx'+kx=F(t); the discriminant sets the damping regime.

subtopics.label: Resonance
subtopics.summary: Driving at the natural frequency makes the amplitude grow linearly in t.
